name: Switch
description:
The Switch component is a toggle input that allows users to switch between two states, such as turning a setting on or off.

Use the default `<Switch>` for a labeled switch with the Cerberus check indicator, or compose the primitives for full structural control. To use it within a form, wrap it with the Field component.

parts.name: El
parts.description: An abstraction that renders a labeled switch with the Cerberus check indicator in the thumb

parts.name: Root
parts.description: The root container of the Switch component.

props.name: size
props.description: PandaCSS recipe variant for size.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the switch. Useful for composition.

props.name: label
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the switch is disabled.

props.name: invalid
props.description: If `true`, the switch is marked as invalid.

props.name: required
props.description: If `true`, the switch input is marked as required,

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the switch is read-only

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Function to call when the switch is clicked.

props.name: checked
props.description: The controlled checked state of the switch

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: The initial checked state of the switch when rendered. Use when you don't need to control the checked state of the switch.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the input field in a switch (Useful for form submission).

props.name: form
props.description: The id of the form that the switch belongs to

props.name: value
props.description: The value of switch input. Useful for form submission.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merges props and accessibility attributes onto the immediate child element instead of rendering a wrapper DOM node.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Strips Cerberus PandaCSS recipe classes while preserving behavior and WAI-ARIA attributes.

props.name: css
props.description: PandaCSS style object for custom atomic styling. All PandaCSS style props (e.g. p, bg, color) are also accepted.
